author: ObsidianDev2026
title: Is there a way to export my Claude project conversations to Obsidian Markdown?
snippet: I have spent months writing technical specs in Claude. The web interface is getting sluggish and I want all my chats saved as markdown notes locally.
draft_response:
Founder and developer of TotalRecalls here.

This exact frustration is why I built TotalRecalls for Windows 10/11. Whenever you download your history, every single conversation is saved twice into C:\TotalRecalls\Library\<provider>\:
• Clean Markdown (.md) with code blocks, timestamps, and citations intact—which opens natively as an Obsidian vault or in Notion.
• Structured JSON (.json) for local scripting.

There is a permanent Free Tier covering ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity (5 chats each) so you can test the file output before buying: https://totalrecalls.app/
Certified on the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP1KKD5X2D6
